overrides.note: Added in 2.0.0. The source renders per-section tone only; styleTokens lets a generator make a constrained token choice per node and is validated against the real catalog/themes. Absent = the section contract's own tokens. It is not evidence of a source feature.

pageSpecField: nodes[].styleTokens (optional, closed: surface, text, border, sectionPaddingY, headingStyle, fontFamily, radius)

surface.accepts: tone.surface.* role, or the color.* id the node's tone theme resolves a surface role to

text.accepts: tone.text.* role, or the color.* id the node's tone theme resolves a text role to

border.accepts: tone.border.* role, or the theme-resolved color.* id

fontFamily.accepts: a catalog supportedFonts id (fontFamily.sans = Inter Variable, OFL-1.1)

rules.TOKEN_UNKNOWN: value is not a token id in tokens/llm/token-catalog.json, or is a token of the wrong category for the slot
rules.TOKEN_RAW_VALUE: raw hex / rgb() / hsl() / named colour or a raw dimension instead of a token id
rules.TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING: sectionPaddingY is not on the measured spacing scale
rules.TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT: fontFamily is not a supported font token
rules.TOKEN_THEME_MISMATCH: a color.* id that the node's tone theme (tokens/themes/<tone>.json) does not resolve that role group to
